_meta.description: Per-holdco mapping to the underlying listed operating businesses whose value drives the holdco NAV. Used by (a) the analysis page to surface 'Underlying holdings' in place of a peer cohort for pure holding companies, and (b) backend/services/holdco_sotp_service.py to compute Sum-of-the-Parts valuations. Tickers are NSE bare symbols (no .NS suffix). Empty list = constituents are unlisted / private (still classified as holdco; just no link-out is provided).
_meta.source: NSE filings + financial press coverage of pure investment companies (2026-06-09).
caveats: The list is not exhaustive — promoter group cross-holdings and small unlisted stakes are intentionally omitted to keep the surface focused on what a retail user can themselves analyze.
When a holdco's primary underlying is itself unlisted, the array is empty rather than seeded with a parent group name — emitting an unlisted symbol would break the link-out.
Maintained in sync with backend/services/analysis/constants.py::HOLDING_COMPANIES — every key here MUST also be in HOLDING_COMPANIES (test guards this).

T1.4 Phase A (2026-06-10) added a parallel `_sotp_data` block carrying per-holdco stake percentages, sector-tuned discount defaults, and Phase A status. The top-level ticker keys still resolve to a flat list of underlying tickers for backward compatibility with peers_service / eli15_thesis_service / the legacy JSON-shape test.

Stake percentages in `_sotp_data` are best-effort plausibility estimates drawn from public FY25 disclosures and are NOT a substitute for an annual refresh from primary sources (BSE shareholding filings, annual reports). Treat them as data shape, not as production ground truth — accuracy ingestion is a separate task.

shape_versions.v1_legacy: Top-level keys map to a flat list of underlying NSE tickers (e.g. "BAJAJHLDNG": ["BAJAJ-AUTO", "BAJFINANCE", "BAJAJFINSV"]). Consumed by backend/services/peers_service.py::_maybe_holdco_underlyings and backend/services/eli15_thesis_service.py::_lookup_holdco_underlyings.
shape_versions.v2_sotp: Parallel `_sotp_data` block keyed by the same holdco tickers, each carrying { underlyings: [{ticker, stake_pct, is_listed}], default_discount_pct, note }. Consumed by backend/services/holdco_sotp_service.py (T1.4 Phase B will wire this into composite_iv_service.py).

_sotp_data._note: Per-holdco SOTP inputs. Stake percentages are plausibility estimates as of FY25 disclosures; needs annual refresh from primary sources. default_discount_pct mirrors get_sector_holdco_discount in holdco_sotp_service.py — duplicated here so the seed is self-describing without needing to import the service.

BAJAJHLDNG.note: Bajaj Holdings & Investment. Three Bajaj-group financial / industrial subs. Stake percentages need verification against FY25 BSE shareholding filings.

TATAINVEST.note: Tata Investment Corporation. Diversified Tata-group basket — stakes are typically small (< 2%) but the aggregate NAV is meaningful because the underlying mcaps are very large.

MAHSCOOTER.note: Maharashtra Scooters — Bajaj-group second-tier holdco. Smaller stakes than BAJAJHLDNG.

PILANIINVS.note: Pilani Investment & Industries — Birla-group holdco. Holds stakes in Aditya Birla group flagship listed entities.

KAMAHOLD.note: Kama Holdings — SRF promoter vehicle. Single concentrated stake makes NAV-to-CMP discount the dominant driver.

SUMMITSEC.note: Summit Securities — small financial-sector holdco. Stakes are illustrative; original seed had no underlyings — these are placeholder estimates that should be replaced with actual disclosure data before relying on the SOTP.

WILLIAMAGR.note: Williamson Magor — Eveready / McLeod holdco. Eveready stake is unlisted in this seed (its listing status changed historically); flagged is_listed=false so Phase A skips it from the aggregate.

MCLEODRUSS.note: McLeod Russel — tea-estate holdco. Underlying tea estates are unlisted operating units; Phase A skips with a warning. Production needs book-value fallback for unlisted underlyings.

NDTV.note: New Delhi Television — media holdco. All underlying operating units (content production, broadcasting) are unlisted; Phase A returns method=unavailable for NDTV until book-value fallback ships.

NETWORK18.note: Network18 Media — Reliance media holdco. TV18 listing status varies by group reorganizations; HATHWAY (cable) is listed.

GAYAHWS.note: Gayatri Highways — toll-road SPV holdco. Underlying toll concessions are unlisted SPVs; Phase A returns method=unavailable.

MOIL.note: MOIL — classified as holdco in the source set due to manganese mine leasing structure, but in practice operates rather than purely holds. Phase A returns method=unavailable; if MOIL is reclassified as an operating company (out of HOLDING_COMPANIES), this entry becomes dead and can be dropped.

GRASIM.note: Grasim Industries — Aditya Birla conglomerate holdco. UltraTech (cement) and Aditya Birla Capital (financial services) are the major listed stakes; standalone VSF (viscose) and other businesses are unlisted operating segments. SOTP rather than DCF is the right frame because the UltraTech stake alone dominates the NAV.
